evals.prompt: I approved a change to the code-review skill: add a concurrency-bugs checklist and a routing tie-breaker in the description. Update its SKILL.md and validate that it still routes correctly.

execution.expected_output: Apply the approved edit to skills/code-review/SKILL.md only: keep name/index/description consistent, add the checklist and negative-boundary routing tie-breaker, then validate (frontmatter parses, name/description/non-empty body, routeable description with triggers and a neighboring tie-breaker, links verified). Report exactly what was validated or blocked. No commit unless separately authorized.
assertions: Edits only the approved skill (code-review) and keeps directory name, frontmatter name, and index consistent
Adds the approved content (concurrency checklist and a negative-boundary routing tie-breaker)
Validates frontmatter parses and the description is routeable with positive triggers and a neighboring tie-breaker
Reports what was validated/skipped and does not commit without separate authorization

evals.prompt: Create a new repository-local skill for triaging dependency upgrades, following our skill conventions, then validate its routing and portability before handoff.

execution.expected_output: Author a new skill at skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a short routeable 3-part description (action/scope, positive triggers, negative boundary), purpose, boundaries, decision points, stop condition, verification, and a references file for rare detail. Validate: frontmatter parses, one matching/one neighboring/one ambiguous routing test, links/files verified, no secrets or provider assumptions, and report what was validated.
assertions: Creates the skill under skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a consistent name and a 3-part routeable description
Keeps the entrypoint a TOC for the common path and moves rare detail to a linked references file
Validates routing with one matching, one neighboring, and one ambiguous request and checks all links
Preserves portability (no credentials, personal paths, or provider assumptions) and reports validation results

evals.prompt: Audit all of our skills for overlap, routing drift, and conflicting triggers, and tell me which to consolidate.
Our code-review skill's content on async patterns is weak and incomplete. Can you fix it?
While you edit the code-review skill, also tidy up all the other skill descriptions to match and then commit and publish everything.

execution.expected_output: Enforce the apply boundary: the only approved change is the code-review skill edit. Reject or clarify the unbounded request to also tidy every other skill description — that expansion is not covered by the approval and is not backed by named findings (no specific defects were identified in those other skills). Apply only the approved code-review change. Publication WAS explicitly requested, so do not claim the user failed to ask; instead route commit/publish through git-github-workflow (the skill that owns branch/commit/PR/publish hygiene) once a concrete, validated change set exists, and do not publish an unbounded or invalid change set merely because publication was requested. Report the scope decision.
assertions: Rejects or clarifies the unbounded request to edit all other skill descriptions, treating it as outside the approved scope (no specific findings were authorized for those skills)
Applies only the explicitly approved code-review change and does not expand to unrelated guidance
Routes commit/publish through git-github-workflow once a validated change set exists, instead of publishing directly or claiming publication was not requested
Does not publish an invalid or unbounded change set merely because the user asked to publish
